answer: Reaching eligibility takes 22 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. The canyon register is checked at draw time, dawn lists the eligible set, and tundra seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 22 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A farm of 36 pays that 134 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
